tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// thub pa gnas brtan 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi rim pa rdzogs ldan bsod nams sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od rdul lhung tsam gyis// srid zhi'i dge legs sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan tshal// gcig car bzhad pa thub mchog nyin mor byed// 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i bsang mchod chu 'dzin spro// 'dir thub pa gnas brtan bcu drug bcas pa'i bsang mchod bya bas/ nyer spyod phye mar shing rtsi sna tshogs kyi dud pa btang ba spyi ltar byas la/ bsang mchod gzhan dang ma 'brel tshe/ sangs rgyas chos sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ spyan 'dren ni/ hrīḥrang nyid lhar gsal snying ga'i sa bon las// 'od zer pho nya grangs med 'phros pa'i mod// rang bzhin lhun grub gar bzhugs gnas rnams nas// thub dbang gnas brtan 'khor bcas da tshur spyon// bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ nam mkhar 'phrog byed brgyad kyis bteg pa'i khrir// chu skyes zla ba bkod legs gdan steng la// ston pa bstan skyong gnas brtan 'khor tshogs bcas// 'gro ba'i don phyir de srid brtan par bzhugs// gsal gdab pa ni/ bsod nams brgya phrag gis bskrun dge mtshan dang*// dpe byad 'bar ba kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen// chos gos gsum mdzes rdo rje skyil krung bcas// bdud 'dul mnyam par bzhag pa'i phyag rgyas bzhugs// 'khor du lung rtogs bstan pa 'dzin skyong dang*// spel bar gnyer gtad gnas brtan dgra bcom tshogs// mtshams sprin phung po 'char ka'i ma zlum dang*// mnyam par 'grogs ltar ngo mtshar mig gi dpyid// yan lag 'byung dang ma pham nags na gnas// dus ldan rdo rje mo bu bzang po pa// gser be'u bhā ra dhwa dza gser can mchog /'phags pa ba ku la dang sgra gcan 'dzin// lam phran bhā ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len// lam brtan klu'i sde sbed byed mi phyed pa// rang rang 'khor gyi thos sgrogs dgra bcom bcas// kun gyi zhabs 'bring dge bsnyen dharmā tā// thang dzu'i dzung gi rgyal khab 'phags pa'i tshogs// bsod nams shing rtas g.yar 'dren ha shang dang*// chos 'khor bsrung zhing de yi mi mthun phyogs// mthar byed rgyal po chen po bzhi dang bcas// kun gsal dbang sngon zhun ma'i rtsig logs su// rnam rig tshangs pa'i rdzu 'phrul pir gyi rtses// mthong na mi mthun med pa'i gzugs brnyan 'bum// bkrag cher bris pa'i ltad mo lham mer gsal// bsang mchod spel ba ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bde gshegs sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum// 'bru gsum rnam par shar ba'i sbyong spel gyis// mchod rdzas bsang rdzas rnam dag ye shes kyi// rang snang 'gag med bskal par 'byung gyur cig /bsang mchod stab pa ni/ ring nas nyer spyad 'dod pa'i yon tan la// bsags bsung nyes skyon 'phags pa rnams la med// gang phyir ci 'dod lhun grub 'jo ba dang*// dag pa'i bdag nyid gtsang byar ci zhig mchis// 'on te bdag sogs bsod nams tshogs bsag dang*// sgo gsum nyes skyon duḥkha sbyang phyir du// yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*// chu skyes thang skyes 'dab stong bdug pa'i sprin// snang gsal dri chab bshos dang sil snyan dbyangs// dri 'dzin tshim par byed pa'i sman spos dang*// dbyar skyes legs bris rkang 'thung gzhon du yi// yal 'dab me tog 'bras bu g.yur za ba// mtshun zar bsregs pa'i dri zhim rdzogs ldan sprin// ma dag nyes skyon mthun pa min pa'i phyogs// legs sbyangs gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i dpal// ci yang 'jo bas zhing kun khyab pa 'dis// skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog gsum gyi ngos// lha mi'i ston pa bcom ldan zas gtsang sras// gnas brtan bcu drug dgra bcom zhabs 'bring ba// skal bzang ha shang bka' sdod rgyal chen bcas// bsang ngo mchod do dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes// bdag cag yon sbyor gyis mtshon sems can gyi// rang bzhin bcas pa'i sdig ltung nyes skyon rnams// sprin bral mkha' ltar dag pa'i bdag nyid stsol// 'dod don gsol ba ni/ bde legs 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i lung rtogs chos// mkhas tshul gsum gyi snang byed brtse ba che// rgyal tshab kun bzang bcas pa'i ring lugs mchog /phrin las snang bas phyogs mthar 'gengs par shog /sde snod gsum dang gsang chen rgyud kyi don// 'dzin 'chad mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams// 'chad rtsom brtsad pas rgyal bstan nyin mor byed// 'khor ba'i mun 'phrog yun ring brtan par mdzod// bstan pa'i snang byed brtse chen snying po dang*// kun dga' bzang bsten dpyad gsum rnam dag gi

/rjes 'jug bshad sgrub lhur len ngur smrig 'chang*// grangs med 'dus pas dbyig 'dzin dog por mdzod// dkon mchog mchod dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur mkhan// sbyin bdag rnams kyi bde dga' rigs rgyud bcas// stobs 'byor tshe ring rdzogs ldan 'khor sgyur gyi// mnga' thang thams cad de der 'phos snyam mdzod// yul gru 'dis mtshon ljongs 'khod sems can khams// bde skyid lo legs dpal 'byor rgyas pa la// rjes chags dge ba bcu yang de dag gi /sgo gsum la zhugs longs su spyod snyam mdzod// tshul 'dir 'bad med byang chub snying po'i bar// dal ba'i mtsho ldan skyabs gsum zla ba yi// cod paṇa legs 'chang lnga rig rgyan gyis mdzes// chos kun snyan ngag rgyud mangs glur 'jo mdzod// rnam dkar dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba yi// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nyes pa kun sbyangs nas// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i snying po chos gzugs sku// zung 'jug la gor grub pa nyid gyur cig /phywa g.yang dgug pa ni/ hrīḥ'ajig rten gsum gyi dga' bde dpal 'byor dang*// 'jig rten las 'das mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpal// thams cad dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i mthus// tshur bsdus sde bzhi'i dpal kun 'phel bar mdzod// bsang mchod gzhan dang 'brel na mi dgos kyang*/ ma 'brel na gshegs gsol ni/ thugs rje'i sems can don phyir byon pa'i mgron// yid can mngon 'dod re ba yongs bskangs nas// skye med dbyings su bzhud pa'i tshul ston yang*// smon lam dbang gis ma 'gag skur ston cig /smras pa/ 'dod yon lnga rdzogs mchod pas rab 'byams zhing*// 'gengs pa kun tu bzang po'i spyod par snyad// dngos grub ci 'dod 'jo bas sngon rabs kyi// mi bdag bsod nams mthu dpal rjes su 'jug /tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i rnam dkar dge bas bdag /mchod yul 'phags bzhi mchod pas mnyes byed cing*// sbyin yul 'gro drug sbyin pa rnam bzhi yi// re ba bskang ba'i mgon po nyid gyur cig

/ces thub pa gnas brtan 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga rdzogs ldan sprin phung zhes bya ba 'di ni/ kun dga' rin chen gyis bskul ngor tshul rin gyis sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
